summary: Recognize native Factorio 2.0 offshore-pump fluids in acquisition and progression.
details: Both modern targets read the fluid declared by a tile through the pump's native source offset. Factorio 2.0 water can supply a selected lab or science recipe without erasing its crafting machine's research unlock.

A fluid-box filter cannot invent an absent fluid. The former explicit pump fluid field remains native on the seven older targets and cannot override the modern tile source or supply one without its offset.

Controlled canonical lab, researchability and source-epoch checks cover the nine line contracts and prototype immutability. Native pump acquisition or placement, world tile availability, power, fluid delivery, production, catalogue and saved-world behavior remain unqualified; no permission, owner or support claim is granted.
